advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a plan-review test asserting plan_review_decide emits the correct outcome_counts (clean / recovered / empty_outcomes), including the too_big/shed interaction unique to the plan-review branch.
evidence: tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_workflow.py:549-554 test_decide_op_partitions_findings asserts blocking/surfaced only — `assert set(out) >= {"blocking", "surfaced", "overflow", "indeterminate", "dropped"}` — never checks outcome_counts
ABSENCE: search for 'outcome_counts' across tests returns hits ONLY in test_review_kernel.py and test_code_review_workflow.py — zero in any plan-review test file
advisory.finding: plan_review_decide now emits an outcome_counts key (plan_review/workflow_ops.py:496-497) but no test asserts it. The plan-review branch has extra complexity the code-review branch lacks — findings pass through too_big/shed filtering while decide_outcome_counts is computed over the full findings list and reshape over range(len(findings)) — so a regression in the plan-review outcome_counts tally would not be caught by any existing test.
advisory.suggested_fix: Extend test_decide_op_partitions_findings (or add a sibling) to assert out["outcome_counts"] == {clean:1,...} for the conforming case, and a recovered case mirroring test_decide_op_records_contract_violation_without_changing_outcome.
